bids.description:
When it comes to automating complex systems, I'm your guy. My name is Ammar Ahmed and I've spent years building automation systems and full-stack platforms, including SaaS applications to streamline processes and boost efficiency. With my expertise in API integration and automation, I can effortlessly set up the entire lead generation process, ensuring every form submission on the landing page you provide is captured effectively in Meta Ads Manager.

In addition to my proficiency with popular tools like n8n, Make, and GoHighLevel, I have immense experience in campaign management on Facebook and Instagram, right from structuring ad sets to targeting audiences strategically. Crafting compelling copy comes naturally to me after creating successful campaigns for numerous clients. Installing pixels and tracking conversions will be implemented seamlessly into our strategy, so you'll get clear insights every week without breaking a sweat.

Lastly, don't fret about the cost per lead; my approach integrates automated rules and workflows that can pause under-performing ads in real-time while scaling up winners - exactly what you need for optimized campaigns. Alongside, a weekly auto-generated performance report (CSV, Sheet) will give you detailed updates without manual labor. Trust me with this project- I've delivered results in similar endeavors and never compromised on quality or timeliness.

Hi, there,

If your goal is to get more quality leads, sales and better returns from your Meta Ads budget, I can help you achieve that through a focused Facebook & Instagram Ads strategy.

I will first understand your business, target customers and goals, then build campaigns designed around real business results—not just clicks or impressions.

My work will include:

• Campaign setup and management
• Audience & competitor research
• Ad copy and creative testing
• Pixel & conversion tracking
• Retargeting campaigns
• Budget and audience optimization
• Regular performance monitoring
• Improving CPL, CPA and ROAS

I will continuously test audiences, creatives and messaging, then optimize the campaigns based on actual results.

My focus is simple: reduce wasted ad spend and generate more quality customers.

Please share your website and current Meta Ads details, and I can review them and suggest the right strategy.

Looking forward to working with you.

Hi There,

Hope you are well.

I specialize in lead-driven advertising on Meta platforms, focusing on building, optimizing, and automating campaigns to generate qualified leads. I can handle the full funnel process, from setting up ad campaigns to tracking conversions and creating automated rules for continuous performance improvement. Let's discuss further!

Thanks in advance for the opportunity to working with you.

Best Regards,
Serazum

Being a seasoned tech professional with extensive experience in digital marketing, I am confident that I can meet and exceed your needs for this Meta lead generation project. My skills in API integration and website design are highly applicable in setting up the campaigns, tracking conversions, and creating automated rules and workflows. And let's not forget my invaluable proficiency in Social Media management which makes me a perfect fit for running ads on Facebook and Instagram.

Lastly, I always deliver reliable, scalable, and practical solutions that meet clients' expectations and budgetary limiting factors. This means that I'll provide you with a clean campaign framework ready to publish while ensuring every lead from the external page is captured inside Ads Manager— all at an agreed-upon cost per lead target. With me on board, you can count on weekly auto-generated performance reports filled with actionable insights without having to lift a finger! Can't wait to discuss further how I can contribute effectively to your project!

Hi,

I’m Fahad Kahn, and I can help build a lead-generation funnel across Facebook and Instagram designed to attract qualified prospects and make campaign performance easier to monitor. I’ll structure the campaigns and ad sets around your target audiences, develop compelling ad copy, and align the messaging with the external landing page you provide.

I’ll configure Meta Pixel and, where supported, Conversions API tracking to record external landing-page form submissions in Ads Manager, then test the complete conversion journey to verify that leads are being recorded correctly. I’ll also establish automated rules to flag or pause underperforming ads and scale stronger performers within agreed limits, alongside a weekly performance report delivered as a CSV or connected Sheet. The setup will focus on reliable tracking, clear reporting, and decisions guided by actual campaign data.

Before launch, I’ll confirm the conversion event, tracking access, and target cost per lead so the campaign can be evaluated against clear criteria. Actual lead costs and volume will depend on audience response, competition, and landing-page performance.

Best regards,
Fahad Kahn

As an AI expert, with extensive experience in devising and implementing lead generation strategies, I am the perfect fit for your Meta ad campaign. My skillset includes everything you need to ensure a successful campaign from structuring ad sets and audiences to installing pixels and automating workflows. Given my specialty in AI-driven solutions, I've built custom tools for document processing, data extraction, and workflow automation that can be specifically leveraged for your project.

I understand the importance of not just setting up ad campaigns, but optimizing and automating them to improve performance over time. This is where my background as a Chief Technology Officer of an AI-driven startup comes into play. I have led technical developments for multiple advanced digital products that enabled automation rules and continuous performance improvement even when no one is watching.

Lastly, I have developed full-stack SaaS applications with modern dashboards and CRM integrations as well as API integrations and cloud deployments. This means not only can I set up tracking to record every lead but also generate weekly auto-generated reports that provide clear, actionable insights without you having to pull data manually. It would be a privilege to apply my knowledge and expertise towards generating a steady flow of qualified leads for you on Meta through Facebook and Instagram advertisements.

Hi there,

Driving steady, qualified leads through Meta without wasting ad spend requires bulletproof tracking and strict optimization guardrails. I can build, wire up, and automate your entire Facebook and Instagram acquisition funnel.

To ensure every external form submission accurately reports back to Ads Manager, I configure both the standard Meta Pixel and server-side Conversions API (CAPI) using Google Tag Manager. This eliminates data loss from browser blockers and gives the Meta algorithm accurate event signals to optimize toward your target cost per lead.

On the campaign side, I structure targeted cold and warm audience segments, craft high-intent ad copy, and implement automated performance rules directly inside Meta. These rules work on autopilot—automatically scaling high-converting ad sets and pausing underperforming creatives once they hit predefined spend and CPL thresholds. For weekly tracking, I will link your campaign metrics to an automated Google Sheet dashboard so you get clear performance insights without manual exports.

Your meta lead generation initiative sounds exciting and I'm ready to help you streamline this process. To start, I would assess your existing landing page to ensure it’s optimized for conversions before setting up your ad campaigns on Facebook and Instagram. My approach involves creating a strategic framework that defines clear audience segments and compelling ad copy. I will implement conversion tracking to log every lead directly into Ads Manager and set up automation rules that optimize performance. Additionally, you'll receive a weekly performance report so you can easily track progress without manual effort. I have experience in web applications that could tie in automation, as showcased in my project: https://www.freelancer.com/projects/website-design/sunshine-dance-academy-website-for-dance/ for seamless data integration. Let’s discuss how we can make this successful!

What tools or platforms do you currently use for reporting and tracking performances?

I can deliver 'Meta Lead Generation Automation' end to end — clean architecture, tests, and deployment. I'll start with a short plan, share progress daily, and hand over production-ready code. Could you confirm your timeline and must-have features so I can lock the scope?

Hi, I run Meta lead campaigns for my own agency and clients right now, with automated daily audits and weekly reports pulled from the Marketing API, so I can set up the whole funnel for you.

What I'd set up:
1. Tracking first: the Meta Pixel plus the Conversions API (server-side) on your external page, a Lead event that fires only on a successful form submit (not on page view), deduplicated between browser and server, and verified in Events Manager with a real test submission. That is your acceptance check: a submitted form shows up as a lead in Ads Manager.
2. Campaign framework: a Leads objective campaign with 2-3 ad sets (a broad / Advantage+ audience, an interest stack, and a retargeting set once there's traffic), 4-6 ad variations testing hooks and offers, and UTM parameters on every ad.
3. Automated rules: pause an ad when spend exceeds 2x the target CPL with no leads, raise the budget 15-20% on ad sets beating target CPL for 3 days, and notify you on CPM or frequency spikes.
4. Weekly auto-report: a Google Sheet updated by script via the Marketing API (spend, leads, CPL, CTR and frequency by ad and ad set, week over week), plus a short note on what changed and why.

One honest point on acceptance: I can guarantee correct tracking, structure, automation and reporting. A specific CPL depends on your offer, page and market, so we'd set the target together after the first 7-10 days of data rather than promising it upfront.

What is the offer or service the leads are for, and roughly what daily budget do you plan?

We've got the exact skill set this project calls for, ready to go, helping turn Meta advertising into a measurable lead generation system built for consistent performance.

We can structure Facebook and Instagram campaigns around qualified audiences, compelling ad copy, and your external landing page. We’ll configure Meta Pixel and Conversions API where supported, verify form submissions through Events Manager, and establish automated rules to flag underperformers and scale winning campaigns carefully. We can also automate weekly CSV or Google Sheets reports covering spend, leads, cost per lead, and conversion trends. Our focus will be reliable attribution, actionable optimisation, and transparent reporting. Does your landing page support adding the Meta Pixel or server-side tracking, and what target cost per qualified lead should we optimise toward?

We're happy to discuss your funnel and tracking setup to establish a practical launch plan, with clear next steps either way.

Regards, Uzair

Meta Lead Generation campaigns start with Conversions API setup, so every external-page form submission registers as a lead in Ads Manager independent of iOS tracking loss.

Produced using AI tools and checked before delivery.

Konrad

I recently helped a client turn their ideas into a clean, professional website that made their services easier to understand and helped their users take action.

I can do the same for your project, building a fully optimized lead generation automation across Meta platforms. I’ll set up and manage the campaigns, ensuring that every form submission is accurately tracked in Ads Manager while crafting compelling copy that resonates with your target audience.

I’ll handle the entire funnel—from structuring ad sets and audiences to installing pixels and establishing automation rules that keep performance improving even when you’re not monitoring. You’ll receive clear, actionable insights each week without the hassle of manual data pulls.

With 75+ 5-star reviews and a top 1% ranking among 75 million users, you can trust that I know how to deliver results.

If you’re looking for someone to turn your lead generation goals into reality, I’d be happy to work with you.

Regards, 
Wataaka

Your BPO and real estate businesses both live or die on lead quality, not lead volume. I'll set up your Meta lead generation so every rupee of ad spend flows into a clean, trackable pipeline: AI-assisted ad delivery with automation rules that kill underperforming ads early, Meta Pixel plus Conversions API for accurate tracking, lead forms wired straight into your CRM, and a simple reporting dashboard showing cost per qualified lead for each company. For the BPO side, I'll structure lead qualification by calls and messages so your team only chases warm prospects. You get fewer junk leads and a system you can scale to more companies without rebuilding it. Timeline: 7 days to full setup, tested end to end.

Hi, the part most Meta lead campaigns get wrong is tracking. If every form submission isn't recorded as a conversion, the automated rules end up optimising for clicks instead of leads.

My plan:
1. Install the Meta pixel and Conversions API on your landing page, set the form submission as the lead event, and verify it with test leads in Events Manager.
2. Build the campaign framework: separate ad sets for interest, lookalike and retargeting audiences, with 3 to 4 ad copy and creative variations to test.
3. Add automated rules that pause high cost per lead ads and scale winners, plus a scheduled weekly report emailed to you with spend, leads and cost per lead.

I run Maldonado Marketing, a Los Angeles agency, and I'm Marketing Director at a law firm where I manage a large Meta and Google budget focused entirely on lead volume.

What landing page platform are you using, and do you already have a pixel installed?

Alex, Maldonado Marketing

source.description:
I’m ready to launch a lead-driven advertising push across Meta and need someone who can build, optimise, and automate the entire process. The goal is simple: generate a steady flow of qualified leads. Ads will run on Facebook and Instagram, and all traffic will be directed to an external landing page that I will provide. I need you to set up the campaigns, wire up tracking so every form submission is captured inside Ads Manager, and create the automations that keep performance improving even when no one is watching.

Please handle the full funnel—from structuring ad sets and audiences to installing pixels, crafting compelling copy, and putting in place automated rules and reports. I’d like to see clear, actionable insights each week without having to pull data manually.

Deliverables
• Campaign framework ready to publish on Facebook and Instagram  
• Conversion tracking that records every lead from the external page inside Meta Ads Manager  
• Automation rules/workflows to pause under-performers and scale winners  
• A weekly auto-generated performance report (CSV, Sheet, or equivalent)  

Acceptance criteria: a submitted form must register as a lead in Ads Manager at an agreed-upon cost per lead target.
